invulnerability.definition:
n. having the strength to withstand attack
n. the property of being invulnerable; the property of being incapable of being hurt (physically or emotionally)
invulnerability.translation: n. 不会受伤害, 刀枪不入, 无懈可击的

invulnerable.translation: a. 不会受伤害的, 刀枪不入的, 无懈可击的, 无可反驳的

invulnerably.translation: adv. invulnerable（不会受伤害的, 刀枪不入的）的变形
